Stage 1 is read on the built blended groove: the cap (back-drive) side is gated only outside the blend, and the blend spans K 0 to 10.72 deg of the 46.5 deg stroke. Inside it the built cap-side pressure angle is above the family gate 34.47 (43 - atan 0.15) from K 0 to 9.0 deg, above 60 deg to K 3.14, and above the self-locking line 81.47 (90 - atan 0.15) only to K 0.33. So the 'dwell lock' the reading exempts is real for the first 0.33 deg; from 0.33 to 9.0 deg the back-drive is not locked, it runs at 34.5-80 deg, ungated. The rest pose (dK 4.6, cap PA ~52.7) and the taken overhead pose at axial -135 (dK 5.8, ~47) sit in that band. No blended groove can pass a 43 - atan(mu) back-drive gate next to its dwell (the cap angle goes to 90 as the law's slope goes to 0), so the linear read's 35.05 at K 0 is itself an artefact of the law's kink: neither reading measures whether the wearer feels the 35-81 deg back-drive in the first 9 deg of K. Under the family's linear reading, the same claim placement has the cap side at 35.05 deg at K 0 against the mu 0.15 gate of 34.47 and fails at K 0 (fast 86.52); it passes at mu 0.135 (gate 35.31, fast 13.31), so its linear-read friction limit is mu ~0.139 (tan(43 - 35.05)), the same as desmo-slipper's measured jam at mu 0.14.
